CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Which response best shows understanding of Prophecies about the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Prophecies about the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Prophecies about the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Prophecies about the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophecies about the Messiah.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Translation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Translation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Bible Translation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Bible Translation has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Translation.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leadership in Israel has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Leadership in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Stewardship over Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Stewardship over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Stewardship over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship over Creation.

7. Which response best shows understanding of John the Baptist to the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing John the Baptist to the Messiah.
   B. Say John the Baptist to the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of John the Baptist to the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use John the Baptist to the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use Divisions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Divisions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Bible.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Functions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Functions of the Bible.
   B. Apply the teaching of Functions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Functions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Functions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Accounts of Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Accounts of Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Accounts of Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Accounts of Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Accounts of Creation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Use of Natural Resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Functions of the Bible and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Divisions of the Bible and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Bible Translation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
